name: synapse-learn-ai
description: Mono-repo dev orchestrator — inicia backend (.NET) y frontend (Angular) con un comando

scripts.build: dotnet build backend/LearningAgents.slnx -c Release && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: dotnet test backend && npm test --prefix frontend -- --run
scripts.install:all: dotnet restore backend/LearningAgents.slnx && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm install --package-lock-only
